# [AQUÆDICT-A]{.acronym-literal}: Authenticator Quality Prediction Model {#aquaedict-a-prediction-model}

::: {.model-intro .authenticator}
[AQUÆDICT-A]{.acronym-literal} operationalizes the quality factors and subfactors defined by [AQUA-A]{.acronym-literal} [1]. The underlying quality structure remains unchanged; [AQUÆDICT-A]{.acronym-literal} adds prediction metrics for deriving Authenticator quality predictions.

Hover or focus a quality subfactor in the model below to inspect its definition together with the corresponding prediction metric and worked example.
:::
